formula_name: ISO 10816 Rotating Machinery Vibration Severity Trip
description: Evaluates overall vibration velocity RMS against ISO 10816-3 Zone C/D alarm and trip limits.
applicability_conditions: Broadband RMS vibration velocity measured between 10 Hz and 1000 Hz
applicability: overall RMS velocity measured per ISO 10816
non_applicability_conditions: High frequency acceleration enveloping for rolling element micro-spalls
assumptions: ISO 10816-3 Class II/III industrial rotating machinery on rigid foundation
source_reference: ISO 10816-3:2009 Mechanical Vibration Standard — Engineering reference / prototype knowledge - requires engineering validation.
